source.title: Clogher Rural District, "Notice of Result of Elections: Election of Rural District Councillors for the above-named Rural District in the Year 1905", dated 1 June 1905, Claude C. Hamilton, returning officer (PRONI LA/24/3/AD/1; the owner's photographs of 10 November 2026, frames 395 and 397)
source.publisher: Public Record Office of Northern Ireland (Clogher Rural District Council records)
source.check: read from the owner's photographs of the printed notice in two blind transcriptions by separate readers, which agreed on every name, figure and mark; a script checked that each division elects as many as its seats and that the elected are the top of the poll; abodes are not published

note: Triennial election of the rural district council, held with the election of the board of guardians: each district electoral division returned its councillors, who were also its guardians. Polled Wednesday 31 May 1905 with the Tyrone county council election ("Polling took place in Tyrone on the 31st ult.": Belfast News-Letter, 2 June 1905, p. 8); declared the next day. Ballagh returned 2 councillors, unopposed.
